variants.title: Slow coincidence: resolving time with shaped pulses
variants.sample: Cs-137 and Co-60 as two unrelated sources
variants.method: slow coincidence (shaping amplifiers and single-channel analysers)
variants.unknown: the resolving time of the slow coincidence unit
variants.note: A slow unit shapes each pulse to about a microsecond before a single-channel analyser makes the logic pulse, so its resolving time is some twenty times that of a fast unit; the singles rates must therefore be kept lower. Rates and unit width are illustrative lab settings.

source.title: G. F. Knoll, Radiation Detection and Measurement, 4th ed.: slow and fast coincidence circuits, accidental rate 2 tau R1 R2

variants.aim: Count two unrelated sources with a slow coincidence unit (shaping amplifiers and single-channel analysers) at four gate widths, and find its resolving time from the accidental rate, R_acc = 2 tau R1 R2.
